sheet_meta.name: Pip Item Combine Gesture
sheet_meta.notes: Full-body off-axis 3/4 one-shot gesture sequence showing Pip combining two items (threading/inserting). Emphasizes hand work and concentrated focus. Shows progression from setup → active combination (furrowed brow, intent) → completion (satisfaction). One-shot sequence, not looping. Firefly generation with magenta background removed via connected-component chroma-key.
